text: Parks, Forestry and Recreation is replacing its registration and booking software in the fourth quarter of 2024. Staff presented at the January 31, 2024 meeting and received feedback from the advisory committee. The purpose of this presentation is to provide an update on the gender data collection in the registration and booking system.

The Two-Spirit, Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender and Queer Advisory Committee: 1. Requested Parks, Forestry and Recreation staff to consider removing the option of "transsexual" and add "transperson" to the registration and booking software gender options. 2. Requested Parks, Forestry and Recreation staff to consider removing the option of "FTM (female-to-male)" from the registration and booking software gender options. 3. Requested Parks, Forestry and Recreation staff to consider removing the option of "MTF (male-to-female)" from the registration and booking software gender options. 4. Requested Parks, Forestry and Recreation staff to consider reporting back on additional changes to the gender options in the registration and booking software systems.
